s:tottori/tottori-sand-dunes: Wide-angle view from the crest of the Umanose ridge at Tottori Sand Dunes: wind-rippled golden sand sloping steeply down to the deep blue Sea of Japan, a few tiny distant walkers on the slope, late-afternoon side light casting long ripple shadows, clear early-autumn sky.
s:tottori/uradome-coast: View from a cliff-top trail over the Uradome Coast: jagged pale granite islets topped with gnarled black pines rising from extremely clear turquoise water, sea caves and rock arches, a small sightseeing boat far below, bright summer sunshine, calm sea.
s:tottori/mizuki-shigeru-road: Eye-level view along a quiet shopping street in Sakaiminato lined with small dark bronze statues of folklore yokai creatures on low stone pedestals, low traditional shopfronts behind, soft overcast morning light, damp paving reflecting the bronze, a few small distant pedestrians.
s:tottori/daisen: Mount Daisen seen from the west across harvested rice fields: a broad, symmetrical volcanic cone with a light dusting of snow on the summit, beech forest on the lower slopes glowing red and orange in late autumn, crisp clear morning air, soft golden light.
s:tottori/mitokusan: Looking up from the rocky trail at Mitokusan Nageiredo: a small ancient unpainted wooden Buddhist hall with a weathered grey roof, set into a shallow overhang in a sheer grey cliff and propped on slender wooden stilts, red and yellow autumn maples around, soft overcast light.
s:tottori/misasa-onsen: Dusk along the Mitoku River at Misasa Onsen: a low bridge over shallow rippling water, wooden ryokan with grey tiled roofs lining the bank, a row of warm glowing paper lanterns reflected in the river, light steam rising, deep blue evening sky.
s:tottori/kurayoshi-shirakabe: Eye-level view along the narrow Tamagawa canal in Kurayoshi: a row of old storehouses with white plaster walls, black charred-cedar lower boards and red-brown roof tiles, small single-slab stone bridges crossing the water, soft spring morning light, no people.
s:tottori/hanakairo: Elevated view from the circular covered walkway at Tottori Hanakairo: broad beds of red, pink and yellow tulips in spring, a glass dome greenhouse at the centre, the wide slopes of Mount Daisen rising behind with late snow streaks, clear blue sky, bright midday light.
f:tottori/matsuba-crab: A whole boiled matsuba snow crab, bright orange-red shell and long legs neatly arranged on a large ceramic platter, a few split legs showing sweet white meat, a small dish of vinegar beside, on a dark wooden ryokan table, 45-degree angle, soft window light, shallow depth of field.
f:tottori/gyukotsu-ramen: A bowl of Tottori beef-bone ramen: clear golden-brown broth with straight noodles, thin chashu slices, chopped green onion and bamboo shoots, in a simple white ceramic bowl on a worn wooden counter, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, light steam, shallow depth of field.
f:tottori/nijusseiki-pear: Several Nijisseiki pears, round with smooth pale yellow-green skin, one cut into wedges showing crisp juicy white flesh, on a white plate on a light wooden table, overhead angle, soft late-summer daylight, shallow depth of field.
f:tottori/sakaiminato-kaisendon: A seafood rice bowl at a Sakaiminato harbour diner: rice topped with glossy red tuna slices, orange salmon roe, shredded snow crab, white fish sashimi, a shiso leaf and wasabi, a bowl of miso soup beside, on a plain wooden table, overhead angle, natural light.
s:shimane/izumo-taisha: Front view of the Kaguraden hall at Izumo Taisha: a massive braided rice-straw shimenawa rope, thick and pale gold, hanging across the entrance beneath a broad gabled roof, plain unpainted wood, white gravel courtyard, a few small distant visitors, soft overcast light.
s:shimane/hinomisaki: View from the cliff-top path at Hinomisaki: a tall slender white stone lighthouse standing on rugged dark rock cliffs above the deep blue Sea of Japan, waves breaking white below, a few tiny distant walkers, bright clear summer afternoon.
s:shimane/matsue-castle: Matsue Castle from its grounds: the original keep clad in weathered black wood with white plaster upper walls and layered grey tiled roofs with curved gables, rising above a steep stone base, cherry trees in full pale pink bloom around it, clear spring sky.
s:shimane/lake-shinji: Sunset over Lake Shinji from the eastern shore in Matsue: calm water glowing gold and red, the small pine-covered islet of Yomegashima as a dark silhouette in the middle distance, low hills on the horizon, low sun, a few tiny distant figures along the shore.
s:shimane/adachi-museum: View through a large picture window at the Adachi Museum of Art: a meticulously pruned garden of raked white gravel, rounded clipped shrubs and pines flowing into forested hills with a slender distant waterfall, maples in red and orange, soft clear autumn daylight, dark window frame.
s:shimane/tamatsukuri-onsen: The Tamayu River in Tamatsukuri Onsen: a shallow stream between stone embankments lined with cherry trees in bloom, small vermilion footbridges, low traditional inns along both banks, wisps of steam, soft late-afternoon spring light.
s:shimane/iwami-ginzan: Eye-level view along the quiet main street of Omori in Iwami Ginzan: low wooden merchant houses with red-brown roof tiles, latticed fronts and earthen walls, a narrow stone-lined water channel, green forested hills rising behind, soft overcast light, no people.
s:shimane/tsuwano: Tonomachi street in Tsuwano: white plaster walls with black-and-white diamond-patterned namako tiles, a clear stone water channel beside the road full of large orange and white koi, purple irises along its edge, green mountains behind, soft early-summer light.
f:shimane/izumo-soba: Warigo soba: three stacked round lacquered dishes of dark speckled buckwheat noodles topped with grated daikon, chopped green onion, shredded nori and bonito flakes, a small pitcher of dipping sauce beside, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:shimane/shijimi: A lacquered bowl of shijimi miso soup filled with small dark glossy freshwater clams in cloudy pale-brown broth with a little chopped green onion, on a wooden tray with rice and pickles at a ryokan breakfast, 45-degree angle, soft morning light, shallow depth of field.
f:shimane/matsue-wagashi: A bowl of frothy bright green matcha in a rustic ceramic tea bowl beside a delicate flower-shaped seasonal wagashi on a small plate with a wooden pick, on a low table in a tatami room, a garden glimpsed behind, 45-degree angle, soft natural light.
f:shimane/izumo-zenzai: A lacquered bowl of Izumo zenzai: warm sweet red adzuki bean soup with whole beans and small round soft white rice cakes, a small dish of salty pickles beside, on a wooden tray, 45-degree angle, soft winter window light, light steam, shallow depth of field.
s:okayama/korakuen: Wide view across Okayama Korakuen: broad emerald lawns and a still pond with a small island, neatly clipped pines and maples in red autumn colour, the black keep of Okayama Castle rising beyond the trees, clear blue sky, soft late-morning light.
s:okayama/okayama-castle: Okayama Castle seen across the Asahi River: a black-clad keep with tiers of grey tiled roofs and golden fish ornaments on the ridges, standing on high stone walls, its dark reflection in the calm water, clear blue sky, bright afternoon light.
s:okayama/kurashiki-bikan: Kurashiki canal at dusk: white plaster storehouses with black tiled roofs and namako-patterned walls lining a narrow stone-edged canal, weeping willows trailing over the water, an arched stone bridge, warm lamps reflected in the calm water, deep blue sky, a few small distant figures.
s:okayama/ohara-museum: Front view of the Ohara Museum of Art near the Kurashiki canal: a small Greek-revival stone building with Ionic columns and a triangular pediment, framed by weeping willows and old white-walled storehouses, soft morning light, no people.
s:okayama/bitchu-matsuyama-castle: Distant view from the opposite ridge at dawn: the small white hilltop keep of Bitchu Matsuyama Castle on a forested mountain above a sea of white morning clouds filling the valley, autumn foliage on the slopes, pale pink and gold sunrise light, still air.
s:okayama/kibitsu-shrine: The long straight covered corridor at Kibitsu Shrine: unpainted wooden pillars under a tiled roof running gently downhill into the distance, clusters of blue, purple and white hydrangeas blooming along both sides in June, soft overcast light, damp stone path, no people.
s:okayama/washuzan: Sunset from the summit of Mount Washu: the Great Seto Bridge spanning the Seto Inland Sea in a chain of suspension and cable-stayed spans over small green islands, calm water glowing gold, island silhouettes layered into haze, granite rocks and pines in the foreground.
f:okayama/white-peach: A ripe Okayama white peach with creamy pale skin and a faint pink blush, one half cut open showing juicy white flesh, on a simple white plate on a light wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft summer daylight, shallow depth of field.
f:okayama/muscat-grapes: A bunch of Muscat of Alexandria grapes with large oval translucent pale-green berries and a soft bloom, on a white ceramic plate on a light wooden table, a few loose grapes in front, 45-degree angle, soft natural window light, shallow depth of field.
f:okayama/demi-katsudon: Okayama demi-katsudon: a bowl of rice and shredded cabbage topped with a sliced golden pork cutlet covered in glossy dark-brown demi-glace sauce and scattered bright green peas, on a tray in an old-fashioned diner, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:okayama/barazushi: Okayama barazushi in a round lacquered box: vinegared rice covered with colourful toppings of Spanish mackerel, shrimp, lotus root slices, golden shredded omelette, snow peas, shiitake and pink fish flakes, on a wooden table, overhead angle, soft natural light.
f:okayama/kibi-dango: Small soft pale-beige kibi dango rice-cake sweets lightly dusted with starch, arranged on a small ceramic plate beside a cup of green tea, on a light wooden table, 45-degree angle, gentle natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:hiroshima/itsukushima-shrine: View from the Miyajima shore at high tide: the vermilion O-torii gate standing in calm sea water, vermilion shrine corridors raised on stilts to one side, forested Mount Misen rising behind, clear late-afternoon light, gentle reflections, a few small distant visitors on the shore.
s:hiroshima/mount-misen: View from the rocky summit of Mount Misen over the Seto Inland Sea: huge weathered granite boulders in the foreground, layers of forested islands fading into blue haze, maple leaves in red and orange on the slopes below, clear crisp autumn afternoon light.
s:hiroshima/peace-park: View across the Motoyasu River to the Atomic Bomb Dome: the skeletal steel frame of the dome atop the ruined brick walls of the old exhibition hall, green trees along the riverbank, calm water reflections, clear morning sky, quiet and respectful, a few small distant figures.
s:hiroshima/shukkeien: Shukkeien Garden in late autumn: a central pond with small islands, a steeply arched stone bridge crossing the water, clipped pines and bright red maples reflected in the still surface, a small teahouse on the bank, soft late-afternoon light.
s:hiroshima/onomichi: View from Senko-ji Park in Onomichi: a hillside packed with old tiled roofs and temple buildings stepping down to the narrow Onomichi Channel, small ferries and the green island across the water, cherry blossoms in the foreground, soft spring morning light, light haze.
s:hiroshima/kosanji: Miraishin no Oka at Kosan-ji on Ikuchijima: an expanse of smooth gleaming white marble sculptures, terraces and curved forms on a hilltop, sharp shadows, deep blue sky, distant Seto Inland Sea islands, bright midday sunlight, a few small distant visitors.
s:hiroshima/okunoshima: Several fluffy wild rabbits in brown and grey sitting on short green grass near the shore of Okunoshima, the calm blue Seto Inland Sea and hazy islands behind, low angle near ground level, soft early-morning sunlight, no people in frame.
s:hiroshima/tomonoura: Tomonoura harbour at dusk: the tall stone Joyato lantern tower standing above broad stone harbour steps descending into calm water, old wooden houses with tiled roofs around the port, small fishing boats, soft pink and blue sky, still reflections.
f:hiroshima/hiroshima-okonomiyaki: Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki on a hot iron teppan: a layered round of thin crepe, cabbage, pork, yakisoba noodles and egg, brushed with glossy brown sauce and sprinkled with green aonori and chopped green onion, a small metal spatula beside, 45-degree angle, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:hiroshima/oysters: Grilled Hiroshima oysters on the half shell, plump and glistening, on a metal grill rack over glowing charcoal at a street stall, a lemon wedge on the side, faint smoke, 45-degree angle, natural winter daylight, shallow depth of field.
f:hiroshima/anagomeshi: Anagomeshi in a round wooden box: slices of grilled conger eel with lightly charred glossy skin laid over sauce-flavoured rice, a few pickles in one corner, on a wooden table, overhead angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:hiroshima/momiji-manju: Several maple-leaf-shaped momiji manju cakes with golden-brown baked surfaces, one broken open to show smooth red bean filling, on a small ceramic plate with a cup of green tea beside, light wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:hiroshima/onomichi-ramen: A bowl of Onomichi ramen: clear brown soy-sauce broth dotted with small floating bits of pork back fat, flat noodles, chashu slices, chopped green onion and bamboo shoots, in a white bowl on a wooden counter, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, light steam.
s:yamaguchi/kintaikyo: Kintai Bridge from the riverbank: five graceful wooden arches on stone piers crossing the clear shallow Nishiki River, cherry trees in full pink bloom along the banks, the small white Iwakuni Castle on the forested hilltop behind, bright spring morning, gentle reflections.
s:yamaguchi/motonosumi-shrine: Elevated view of Motonosumi Shrine: a long line of red torii gates winding down a green grassy cliff to the edge of the deep blue Sea of Japan, dark rocky shoreline and white surf below, bright sunny summer afternoon, clear sky.
s:yamaguchi/tsunoshima-bridge: View from the mainland headland of Tsunoshima Bridge: a long low concrete bridge curving across vivid emerald-green and cobalt-blue shallow sea toward Tsunoshima island, passing a small green islet, clear summer sky, bright midday sunlight.
s:yamaguchi/akiyoshido: Akiyoshidai karst plateau in early autumn: rolling hills of golden pampas grass scattered with countless grey-white limestone pinnacles and boulders, a narrow walking path winding through, wide blue sky with scattered clouds, soft late-afternoon light.
s:yamaguchi/hagi-old-town: A quiet lane in the Hagi samurai district: long white plaster and earthen walls topped with grey tiles, natsumikan orange trees with yellow fruit peeking over the walls, a narrow paved path, soft late-spring sunlight, no people.
s:yamaguchi/karato-market: Inside Karato Market in Shimonoseki on a weekend morning: rows of stalls with trays of colourful nigiri sushi and fugu dishes under bright overhead lights, the harbour and Kanmon Straits visible through open doors, small distant shoppers.
s:yamaguchi/nagato-yumoto: Nagato Yumoto Onsen at dusk: the shallow Otozure River with stepping stones and low terraced stone banks, wooden decks and benches, soft warm lights along the river reflected in the water, traditional inns and green hills behind, deep blue evening sky, light mist.
f:yamaguchi/fugu: Fugu sashimi sliced paper-thin and arranged in a chrysanthemum petal pattern on a large patterned ceramic plate, translucent enough to see the pattern through, with chopped green onion, grated daikon with chilli and a dish of ponzu, 45-degree angle, soft natural light.
f:yamaguchi/kawara-soba: Kawara soba: green tea soba noodles served on a hot dark clay roof tile, topped with sweet-simmered shredded beef, golden shredded omelette, nori strips, a lemon slice and grated daikon, a bowl of warm dipping sauce beside, 45-degree angle, natural light.
f:yamaguchi/iwakuni-sushi: Iwakuni sushi: a large square pressed box sushi cut into thick slices showing multicoloured layers of vinegared rice, lotus root, pink fish flakes, yellow shredded egg and green leaves, on a wooden board, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
